verdict.rationale: The axis applies because a law firm could state offices or qualified practices in several countries. However, Trilegal's own pages describe an India-only footprint: offices in Bengaluru, Chennai, Mumbai, NCR, Pune and GIFT City, with no overseas offices listed. Advising on 'inbound and outbound' M&A is an adjacent capability and does not show offices or qualified practices abroad.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm states its own offices or qualified practices in multiple countries, so expansion does not immediately mean a second firm
